fact: The Fintech Times says mobile wallets linked to state-owned EriTel are emerging as the primary entry point to digital financial services in Eritrea, still limited in functionality.
Himbol's guide says its M-Nakfa mobile money service is active, with cash-in/cash-out, person-to-person, merchant and utility payments, under Bank of Eritrea licensing and supervision.

Himbol Community Financial Services' terms effective November 2025 describe the M-Nakfa mobile money wallet as in operation for cash-in, cash-out, person-to-person transfers, merchant payments and utility bill settlements, under Bank of Eritrea oversight.
